text:
incident-bot: Pager: SEV2 - single-tenant quality regression (AcmeCorp) observed in dedicated-eu-3 (VPC). Start approx 2026-03-16T03:20:00Z. Symptom: structured invoice parsing dropping 'invoice_number' and emitting malformed currency tokens. Model variant: redwood/llama2-13b:q4_2-compact. Paging @tori_oncall.

Tori_oncall: I'm on. Thanks bot. Ben, can you paste the failing sample and any recent rollout/ops events?

Ben_ops: Sample from Acme support ticket: 
```
{"invoice_number": "", "amount": "EUR1200.00", "lines": [{"desc":"monthly sub"}]}
```
Expected invoice_number like "ACME-INV-2026-0731"; customers report ~15% missing.

Ben_ops: Quick grep in deploy logs shows a quant-profile push minutes before symptoms: 
```
2026-03-16T03:17:42Z deployctl promote quant-profile redwood/llama2-13b:q4_2 -> q4_2-compact
2026-03-16T03:17:44Z rollout-target: selector: pool:dedicated-eu-* tenant:all
2026-03-16T03:18:10Z rollout: staged -> 100%
```

Marie_ml: That profile uses a denser remapping to reduce KV cache size; we've always gated it to hosted-only. Looks like selector evaluation changed in last rollout-service patch. Hypothesis: byte remap caused hyphen and uppercase prefix tokens to merge, breaking parser heuristics.

Oliver_sre: Mitigation options: 1) tenant PIN to previous profile (q4_2-stable) 2) pool-level rollback to q4_2-stable (faster) 3) Traffic-split redirect the tenant to a fallback pool with stable profile. Pool rollback fastest (~<60s) but affects any other tenants on pool. What's current blast radius?

Ben_ops: dedicated-eu-3 houses 4 enterprise tenants; only Acme has heavy structured parsing workload. Others low-risk but prefer minimal blast. Customer paused prod traffic; they want immediate restoration.

Tori_oncall: prioritize customer restore. Oliver — do pool rollback now, then apply tenant pin so we avoid re-targeting while RCA happens. Also open bridge.

Oliver_sre: starting rollback. Command: 
```
deployctl rollback --profile q4_2-compact --target-pool dedicated-eu-3 --to q4_2-stable
```
Oliver_sre: rollback triggered 2026-03-16T03:24:02Z.

incident-bot: Incident bridge created: https://meet.redwood/incident/1766000123 - owner: tori_oncall

Devops-bot: Notifying on-call rotation: @marie_ml on deck for postmortem.

Oliver_sre: rollback finished 2026-03-16T03:24:53Z. Running quick validation harness against Acme tenant endpoint.

Ben_ops: ran 80 invoice parse requests: missing invoice_number rate dropped 15% -> 1.25%. Currency token normalization also fixed. Sending sample diffs to bridge.

Acme-sre: AcmeCorp: we resumed limited traffic and initial checks show invoice_number present again. Thank you. Please confirm what caused this and what guarantees you have to stop recurrence.

Tori_oncall: Short answer: a quant-profile rollout targeted dedicated pools by accident due to selector evaluation change. Immediate mitigation: rollback to stable profile and tenant pin. We'll provide detailed RCA and timeline.

Marie_ml: Applying tenant pin to be safe. Command: 
```
redwoodctl tenant pin --tenant acme-corp --model redwood/llama2-13b --profile q4_2-stable --pool dedicated-eu-3
```
Marie_ml: pin applied at 2026-03-16T03:28:05Z. Note: existing connections may need reconnect to pick up pin.

Tori_oncall: Ben, can you sweep logs to confirm if any other tenants saw similar degradation after 03:17Z?

Ben_ops: running cluster-scan... results: only pools matching dedicated-eu-3 and a newly-provisioned dedicated-eu-9 had the compact profile pushed. dedicated-eu-9 has no structured-output tenants. No other customer-facing alerts.

Marie_ml: I'll open INF-10122 for RCA. Immediate triage: rollout-service selector regression introduced dedicated-pools into target set when tenant selector:all present. Adding a short-term guard to disallow dedicated/VPC pools in auto-targeting expressions.

Oliver_sre: Also adding a temporary gate in the deployment system: any profile that changes tokenizer or remap must have a binary canary step that runs structured-output parsing testprompts (we'll add to deploy pipeline).

Emma_csm: Acme is asking: was any user data logged or exposed? They want an assurance for compliance.

Oliver_sre: No evidence of data exfil or external access. Logs indicate normal internal telemetry only. We'll include log excerpts in the postmortem with sensitive fields redacted.

Acme-sre: thanks. They'll want a written timeline and a call. Emma, can you coordinate?

Emma_csm: On it. I'll schedule a 1:1 postmortem and send the short timeline now: rollback completed and pin applied within ~8 minutes of detection.

Devops-bot: Created issue INF-10122: "Quant-profile q4_2-compact auto-targeted dedicated pools due to selector regression" assigned to rollout-team.

Tori_oncall: Action items: 1) roll back confirmed - monitoring (Oliver) 2) tenant pin in place - validation (Marie) 3) patch rollout-service to blacklist dedicated/VPC from auto-targeting by default (Ben + rollout-team) 4) deploy CI canary for structured-output prompts on quant-profile changes (Marie + zara_ml) 5) customer comms & call (Emma).

Marie_ml: Starting token-diff capture for 100 representative invoices to quantify changes. Early observation: hyphen + uppercase prefix consolidated into single token under compact remap; parser rules expected token boundaries. I'll attach diffs to INF-10122.

Ben_ops: Pushed hotfix to rollout-service at 03:41Z to ignore pools with label:dedicated or label:vpc when tenant:all is specified. Hotfix rolled in staging then prod.

Tori_oncall: Good. Let's monitor Acme telemetry for 24 hours. If stable after 24h, we'll close incident and escalate RCA to postmortem.

Oliver_sre: Monitoring dashboard shows stable parse rates; no regressions in next 30m.

Incident-bot: Status update: mitigation applied (pool rollback + tenant pin). Severity downgraded to SEV3.

Ben_ops: small follow-up: add an automated smoke test that runs the structured-output promptset against any quantization profile change and fails the rollout if parse-sensitivity delta > 1%. Low-cost, high-value.

Marie_ml: Agreed. Adding to INF-10122 and scheduling work for next sprint.

Emma_csm: Sent notification to AcmeCorp at 03:47Z: "We rolled back the profile and pinned your tenant; no signs of data exposure. We'll follow up with a full RCA and invite you to a postmortem call." They replied: "Appreciate quick action — please include mitigation plan."

Acme-sre: Confirming Acme happy to take a postmortem call within 48h.

Tori_oncall: Closing bridge now. I'll draft postmortem with timeline, root cause, and remediation steps (including CI canary, rollout-service hard blacklist, and improved release notes for quant-profile changes). Monitoring window: 24h.

Incident-bot: Incident mitigated at 2026-03-16T03:52:00Z. Postmortem issue: https://issues.redwood/INF-10122

Tori_oncall: Thanks team. Quick work. End thread."
